verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document ongoing per-merchant fraud or credit-risk signals, alerts on anomalous sellers, or tools to pause payouts or offboard merchants. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: onboarding-time underwriting verifications, webhooks on merchant application status such as 'Needs Information', and the ability to change deposit frequency for Active merchants.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can watch risk across my seller portfolio — fraud and credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, alerts on anomalous sellers, and tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors
